messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert: multiple auth failures for nimbus-corp VPC during OIDC provisioning. Rate of 401s spiked at 09:03 UTC. Paging oncall.
Maya R: saw the alert, I'm oncall. Confirming impact: new service accounts can't complete OIDC token exchange, existing sessions ok. Customer reports provisioning jobs failing.
Maya R: logs show a 403 on our identity proxy when fetching JWKS for nimbus tenant: 'failed to refresh jwks: 403 forbidden'.
Maya R: attaching quick log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T09:02:57Z identity-proxy nimbus-tenant fetch_jwks failed status=403 path=/keys/tenant-123
2026-03-15T09:02:58Z auth-handler token-exchange error="invalid_signature" src=oidc-provider
```
Ethan L: looking. Checking our JWKS reverse-proxy and the customer's IdP health. @Priya S can you check our VPC egress rules and any recent SG changes? Could be a rotated client cert.
Priya S: no infra changes in the last 24h on the dedicated pool. I can tail the proxy traffic now.
Julian K: opened a support channel with Nimbus, they're seeing failures in their onboarding pipeline. They've attached an IdP log with 'kid missing' for the token key id.
Maya R: hypothesis: Nimbus rotated signing keys on their IdP and we attempted to fetch the new JWKS but got 403 due to a stale client cert used when calling their endpoint from our VPC (mutual TLS). That would explain existing sessions OK (cached keys) and new provisioning failing.
SRE Bot: autoscale triggered for identity-proxy due to increased retries. Current proxy replicas: 3 -> 6.
Ethan L: checking mTLS client cert chain we use for outbound to customer IdP. I see in the cert manager that the client cert used for some tenants failed to auto-rotate at 02:00 UTC (cert-manager logs show 'rotation skipped: lock held').
Ethan L: probable root cause: cert-manager staggered lock collided with a backup job and rotation didn't complete for the nimbus tenant cert. Our outbound client certs are rejected by Nimbus IdP, hence 403 on jwks fetch.
Maya R: customer impact: new service-account provisioning fails (blocking new deployments). Existing tokens still validate until JWKS cache TTL expires (~6h). Severity P1.
Maya R: mitigation options:
- Option A: force re-rotation of client cert for the tenant from our side (requires CDC window and brief outbound connection interruption).
- Option B: ask Nimbus to temporarily allow our old cert thumbprint or permit anonymous JWKS fetch (not ideal).
- Option C: add a short-lived bypass: accept cached JWKS for additional TTL while we fix rotation.
Priya S: I can run forced rotation now for tenant-123. Command is:
```
kubectl -n cert-manager exec deploy/cert-operator -- /bin/certctl rotate --tenant nimbus-tenant-123 --force
```
Priya S: will do a readiness check post-rotation and tail the outbound TLS handshake.
Ethan L: before forcing, add debug headers so we can see the TLS client cert thumbprint Nimbus rejects. Also prepare rollback if their IdP rejects the new cert.
Maya R: go for rotation. I'll notify Nimbus support with planned 30s window and ask them to watch their side.
Priya S: executing rotation now.
SRE Bot: cert-operator: rotation job started (job id=rot-20260315-001) for tenant nimbus-tenant-123.
Priya S: rotation finished, new cert issued. Kube logs show outbound TLS handshake completed and JWKS fetch returned 200. Sample:
```
09:08:12 TLS handshake complete peer=oidc.nimbus.example protocol=TLS1.3 client_cert_thumb=AB:23:... status=OK
09:08:12 fetch_jwks status=200 keys=5
```
Maya R: quick smoke: prov pipeline retried, one job succeeded. Asking Nimbus to validate their onboarding runs.
Julian K: Nimbus confirms onboarding succeeded for a single job. They're continuing to run backfill.
Maya R: monitoring metrics for the next 2 hours. I'll extend JWKS cache TTL fallback for identity-proxy to reduce noisy call volume while clients still stabilize. Setting to 12h temporarily.
Ethan L: adding a routing rule fallback that will send token-exchange to a secondary IdP endpoint if primary returns 403 for 30s. Patch applied to canary route.
Maya R: oncall handoff: I'm handing off to Ethan L at 10:00 UTC for post-incident monitoring and postmortem start. Annotating current state: rotation complete, customer onboarding resumed, no new 403s in last 5m, monitoring alerts suppressed while we watch.
Maya R: next actions for postmortem:
- Root cause: cert-manager lock collision prevented scheduled rotation for tenant cert -> rotation skipped.
- Immediate mitigation: forced rotation, extended JWKS TTL, temporary routing fallback.
- Follow-ups: harden cert-manager locking to avoid backup job interference, add early warning for 'rotation skipped' at 3x threshold, add a canary rotation check after each batch.
Ethan L: taking over monitoring. I'll open a Jira (INFRA-1289) for the follow-ups and schedule a postmortem sync with Cert Infra and Runtime teams.
SRE Bot: alert: incident auto-closed in 1h if no regressions.
Maya R: thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated; will publish preliminary incident note and link to Jira once created. :thumbsup:
summary: P1 - Nimbus VPC OIDC provisioning stall due to outbound client cert rotation skip; forced rotation and temporary fallback applied
